The legacy web agent (Voiceflow project 6696064d23cb7050aa60577a, created 2024-07-16) returns zero sessions, users and interactions for every month of 2024 and 2025 via the Analytics API; the current agents did not exist yet. Publish as 'not tracked'.

methodology.session: One Voiceflow transcript = one session (a widget load or a WhatsApp thread).
methodology.engaged_conversation: A conversation is a session where someone asked something and the assistant answered. Sessions where the greeting appeared but nobody wrote back are not counted, and neither are sessions that ended in an error.
methodology.test_exclusions: We exclude our own testing and anything that isn't a real person using the service.
methodology.channel: web = Voiceflow modality 'chat' on the web agent; whatsapp = modality 'api' on the web agent (FlowBridge era, to May 2026) or any 'api' session on the WhatsApp agent (Jun 2026 onward).
methodology.country: Countries are inferred from where people connect from, and on WhatsApp from the country code of the phone number; we never store phone numbers. Location isn't always available, so this is a floor, not a total.
methodology.language: Languages are detected automatically from the first message in each conversation, so treat them as indicative.
methodology.unique_users_monthly_sum: Voiceflow reports unique users per month; the period figure is the sum of monthly uniques, so a person active in two months counts twice.
methodology.coverage: Conversation-level detail is available for recent months only; earlier periods are reported from summary counts, which is why 2025 is shown differently.
